svg.title: Four evidence-led architecture levels
svg.desc: Start with a flat library, then add static routing, filtered retrieval, and governed runtime controls only when measured local pressure justifies the next level. Every promotion preserves a rollback path.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Choose the smallest level that clears the measured constraint

span.p:
Level 0 · Flat
Small, simple library
Progressive resources

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Level 1 · Route
Stable task domains
Static routing compiler

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Level 2 · Retrieve
Catalog or overlap pressure
Filter, search, inspect

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Level 3 · Govern
Dynamic or higher-risk use
Policy, telemetry, lifecycle

div.style: color: rgb(19, 52, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Promotion evidence
Task outcomes · routing quality · privacy
Latency · cost · drift
